definitions.explanation: The tendency or philosophy of looking at the bright side of things and expecting favorable outcomes. Can refer to a personal attitude or a philosophical position.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{楽観主義|らっかんしゅぎ}の{人|ひと}だ。
{楽観主義|らっかんしゅぎ}だけでは{問題|もんだい}は{解決|かいけつ}しない。
examples.english: Optimism alone won't solve the problem.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}な{状況|じょうきょう}でも{楽観主義|らっかんしゅぎ}を{持|も}ち{続|つづ}けることが、{成功|せいこう}への{鍵|かぎ}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that maintaining optimism even in difficult situations is the key to success.

notes:
USAGE:
{楽観主義|らっかんしゅぎ} uses the {主義|しゅぎ} (-ism) suffix. A person who holds this view is a {楽観主義者|らっかんしゅぎしゃ} (optimist).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽観主義者|らっかんしゅぎしゃ} (optimist)
- {楽観主義的|らっかんしゅぎてき}な (optimistic)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{楽観|らっかん} is the simpler noun/verb meaning "optimism" or "to be optimistic." {楽観主義|らっかんしゅぎ} is more philosophical or ideological.
